recommended.name: Generate a Web Application
recommended.description: Generate a runnable one-page React app (styled-components, inline tokens) plus design doc, issues, and defa manifest ready for the sandbox.

recommended.name: Create Visual Media
recommended.description: Plan and generate AI media: build scripts, scenes, narration, and background music, then optionally mix into shareable audio/video from a single prompt.

recommended.name: Sync Outputs to GitHub
recommended.description: Send generated files, execution results, or manifests directly into a GitHub repository.

why: These workflows will allow you to generate the full-featured mobile-first fitness tracker app, produce visual assets for branding and marketing, and sync outputs to GitHub for version control and collaboration.
